result.rationale: The layout embed.html.erb interpolates `<%= request.referer %>` directly into a single-quoted JS string inside a <script> tag without `escape_javascript` or `json_escape`. A referer containing a single quote or `</script>` breaks out of the string/script context, enabling script injection; only the host portion is validated by ensure_embeddable, not the path/query. Additionally, when no referer is present (or referer host mismatch is tolerated via the layout rendering path), the interpolated value could be empty rendering an invalid targetOrigin for postMessage, breaking the resize handshake.
